cars.title: Cars
cars.description: On the way to the biggest race of his life, a hotshot rookie race car gets stranded in a rundown town and learns that winning isn't everything in life.

cars2.title: Cars 2
cars2.description: Star race car Lightning McQueen and his pal Mater head overseas to compete in the World Grand Prix race. But the road to the championship becomes rocky as Mater gets caught up in an intriguing adventure of his own: international espionage.

cars3.title: Cars 3
cars3.description: Lightning McQueen sets out to prove to a new generation of racers that he's still the best race car in the world.

beemovie.title: Bee Movie
beemovie.description: Barry B. Benson, a bee just graduated from college, is disillusioned at his lone career choice: making honey. On a special trip outside the hive, Barry's life is saved by Vanessa, a florist in New York City. As their relationship blossoms, he discovers humans actually eat honey and subsequently decides to sue them.

shrek.title: Shrek
shrek.description: When fairy-tale creatures are driven into his swamp, a solitary ogre travels with a talkative donkey to rescue Princess Fiona and reclaim his home.

shrek2.title: Shrek 2
shrek2.description: Shrek and Fiona visit her royal parents in Far Far Away, where the Fairy Godmother and Prince Charming scheme to break up their marriage.

shrek3.title: Shrek the Third
shrek3.description: Reluctant to become king, Shrek seeks out a young heir named Artie while Prince Charming plots to take over Far Far Away.

shrek4.title: Shrek Forever After
shrek4.description: Missing his old life as an ogre, Shrek makes a deal with Rumpelstiltskin and finds himself in an altered world where he must win Fiona's love again.

ternetninja.title: Ternet Ninja
ternetninja.description: A ninja doll possessed by a spirit teams up with a teenage boy to seek justice for the murder of a young factory worker.

ternetninja2.title: Ternet Ninja 2
ternetninja2.description: Aske and the Checkered Ninja pursue Phillip Eppermint in Thailand after the villain escapes punishment for his crimes.

click.title: Click
click.description: A workaholic architect discovers a universal remote that lets him skip or revisit moments in his life, but it soon begins controlling his choices.

brucealmighty.title: Bruce Almighty
brucealmighty.description: A frustrated television reporter receives God's powers after complaining about his life and discovers just how difficult it is to take charge of everything.

geostorm.title: Geostorm
geostorm.description: When satellites built to control the weather begin causing deadly disasters, their creator races to uncover the threat before a worldwide storm destroys humanity.

thegreatflood.title: The Great Flood
thegreatflood.description: As a devastating flood sweeps across Earth, a desperate struggle unfolds to save a child from a rapidly flooding apartment building.

leo.title: Leo
leo.description: After decades in a Florida school terrarium, an elderly lizard named Leo and his turtle companion decide to escape into the world outside.

turbo.title: Turbo
turbo.description: A garden snail gains extraordinary speed in a freak accident and pursues his improbable dream of winning the Indianapolis 500.

mazerunner.title: The Maze Runner
mazerunner.description: A teenager with no memory wakes up among other boys trapped inside a huge maze filled with deadly creatures and searches for a way out.

mazerunner2.title: Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials
mazerunner2.description: After escaping the Maze, Thomas and his fellow Gladers enter the dangerous wasteland known as the Scorch, where they search for clues about the organization WCKD and join forces with resistance fighters.

mazerunner3.title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
mazerunner3.description: Thomas leads the escaped Gladers on a dangerous mission to rescue their friends from WCKD by infiltrating the heavily guarded Last City.

interstellar.title: Interstellar
interstellar.description: With Earth becoming increasingly uninhabitable, a group of astronauts journeys through a wormhole to search for a new home for humanity.

spiderman.title: Spider-Man
spiderman.description: After being bitten by a genetically modified spider, teenager Peter Parker gains extraordinary powers and becomes a masked superhero, facing the dangerous Green Goblin.

spiderman2.title: Spider-Man 2
spiderman2.description: Peter Parker struggles to balance his personal life with his responsibilities as Spider-Man while confronting brilliant scientist Otto Octavius, who becomes the villainous Doctor Octopus.

spiderman3.title: Spider-Man 3
spiderman3.description: A mysterious alien symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, bringing out his darker side as he battles new enemies including Sandman and Venom.

amazingspiderman.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
amazingspiderman.description: Peter Parker investigates the disappearance of his parents while discovering his new spider-like abilities and confronting a dangerous reptilian creature known as the Lizard.

amazingspiderman2.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
amazingspiderman2.description: Peter Parker faces powerful new enemies including Electro and the Green Goblin while struggling to protect the people he loves from the growing threats surrounding Oscorp.

spidermanhomecoming.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
spidermanhomecoming.description: Young Peter Parker tries to balance high school life with being Spider-Man while attempting to stop the Vulture, a criminal selling weapons made from advanced alien technology.

spidermanfarfromhome.title: Spider-Man: Far from Home
spidermanfarfromhome.description: During a school trip to Europe, Peter Parker is recruited by Nick Fury to investigate mysterious elemental attacks and encounters a new superhero named Mysterio.

spidermannowayhome.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
spidermannowayhome.description: After his secret identity is revealed, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange for help, but a spell goes wrong and brings dangerous villains from other universes into his world.

spidermanbrandnewday.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
spidermanbrandnewday.description: Four years after the world forgot Peter Parker, he lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man. As the pressure of protecting New York intensifies, unexpected changes to his powers and a powerful new enemy threaten his existence.

charlieandthechocolatefactory.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
charlieandthechocolatefactory.description: A young boy from a poor family wins a golden ticket to tour the mysterious chocolate factory of eccentric candy maker Willy Wonka, alongside four other lucky children.

wonka.title: Wonka
wonka.description: A young Willy Wonka dreams of opening his own chocolate shop in a city famous for its chocolate, but discovers that the industry is controlled by a cartel of greedy chocolatiers.

backtothefuture.title: Back to the Future
backtothefuture.description: Marty McFly, a teenager from 1985, is accidentally sent back to 1955 in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his friend Doc Brown. He must make sure his parents fall in love to secure his own existence and return to the future.

kungfupanda.title: Kung Fu Panda
kungfupanda.description: Po, an enthusiastic but clumsy panda, unexpectedly becomes the Dragon Warrior and must train in kung fu to protect the Valley of Peace from the dangerous Tai Lung.

kungfupanda2.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
kungfupanda2.description: Po and the Furious Five must stop the evil Lord Shen from conquering China with a powerful new weapon. Along the way, Po discovers secrets about his mysterious past.

kungfupanda3.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
kungfupanda3.description: When Po reunites with his long-lost father and visits a hidden panda village, he must train his fellow pandas to defeat Kai, a supernatural warrior who threatens kung fu masters across China.

kungfupanda4.title: Kung Fu Panda 4
kungfupanda4.description: Po is chosen to become the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace and must find a new Dragon Warrior. His journey leads him to confront the Chameleon, a powerful sorceress who can summon villains from his past.

moana.title: Moana
moana.description: When a mysterious curse threatens her island, a courageous young girl named Vaiana sets sail across the ocean to find the demigod Maui and restore balance to her world.

moana2.title: Moana 2
moana2.description: After receiving an unexpected call from her wayfinding ancestors, Vaiana embarks on a dangerous journey into the far seas of Oceania alongside Maui and a new crew of unlikely seafarers.

toystory.title: Toy Story
toystory.description: A cowboy doll named Woody becomes jealous when a new space ranger toy named Buzz Lightyear replaces him as Andy's favorite toy. When they become separated from their owner, the two rivals must work together to find their way home.

toystory2.title: Toy Story 2
toystory2.description: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz Lightyear and the other toys embark on a rescue mission. Meanwhile, Woody discovers his origins as a valuable collectible and must decide between a museum and returning to Andy.

toystory3.title: Toy Story 3
toystory3.description: As Andy prepares to leave for college, Woody, Buzz, and their friends accidentally end up at a daycare center. They soon discover that their new home is controlled by a ruthless teddy bear named Lotso and must find a way to escape.

toystory4.title: Toy Story 4
toystory4.description: Woody, Buzz, and the gang join Bonnie on a road trip with her new handmade toy, Forky. When Forky runs away, Woody sets out to bring him back and unexpectedly reunites with his old friend Bo Peep.

toystory5.title: Toy Story 5
toystory5.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie, and the rest of the toys face a new challenge when modern electronic devices threaten to replace traditional playtime. As Bonnie becomes fascinated with technology, the toys struggle to remain an important part of her life.

thelegomovie.title: The LEGO Movie
thelegomovie.description: Emmet, an ordinary LEGO construction worker, is mistakenly identified as the legendary Special and recruited to join a group of Master Builders. Together they must stop the evil Lord Business from permanently gluing the LEGO universe together.

thelegomovie2.title: The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part
thelegomovie2.description: Five years after the events of the first movie, the LEGO universe faces a new threat from LEGO DUPLO invaders. When his friends are kidnapped, Emmet travels into outer space to rescue them and restore harmony to their world.

ratatouille.title: Ratatouille
ratatouille.description: A rat named Remy dreams of becoming a great chef despite his family's wishes and the difficulties of being a rat. After arriving in Paris, he forms an unlikely partnership with a young kitchen worker named Linguini at a famous restaurant, where they work together to create extraordinary dishes.

angrybirds.title: The Angry Birds Movie
angrybirds.description: On an island populated by happy, flightless birds, Red, Chuck, and Bomb are considered outsiders. When mysterious green pigs arrive on their island, the three birds must uncover what the pigs are planning and save their home.

angrybirds2.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
angrybirds2.description: When a mysterious new enemy threatens both Bird Island and Pig Island, Red and his friends must put aside their rivalry with the green pigs. Together, they form an unlikely alliance to stop Zeta, a dangerous eagle planning to destroy their homes.

dune.title: Dune
dune.description: Paul Atreides, a gifted young man born into a powerful noble family, travels to the dangerous desert planet Arrakis. When his family becomes involved in a deadly struggle over the universe's most valuable resource, Paul must confront his destiny and fight for survival.

dune2.title: Dune: Part Two
dune2.description: Paul Atreides joins forces with Chani and the Fremen to seek revenge against those who destroyed his family. As he rises among the people of Arrakis, he must choose between his love and the fate of the universe while trying to prevent a terrible future.

despicableme.title: Despicable Me
despicableme.description: Gru, a supervillain with an army of little yellow Minions, plans to steal the moon in the greatest heist in history. However, his life changes when he adopts three orphan girls who begin to see him as their father.

despicableme2.title: Despicable Me 2
despicableme2.description: After leaving his criminal life behind to raise his three adopted daughters, Gru is recruited by the Anti-Villain League to help capture a dangerous new supervillain. Together with agent Lucy Wilde, he investigates a mysterious criminal while adjusting to his new life as a father.

despicableme3.title: Despicable Me 3
despicableme3.description: After losing his job at the Anti-Villain League, Gru discovers that he has a long-lost twin brother named Dru. As the brothers reconnect, they become involved in an adventure to stop Balthazar Bratt, a former child star turned supervillain.

despicableme4.title: Despicable Me 4
despicableme4.description: Gru and Lucy welcome a new member to their family, Gru Jr., who enjoys tormenting his father. When the dangerous villain Maxime Le Mal escapes and seeks revenge, Gru and his family must go into hiding while the Minions develop extraordinary new abilities.

projecthailmary.title: Project Hail Mary
projecthailmary.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up alone aboard a spacecraft with no memory of how he got there. As his memories return, he discovers that he has been sent on a desperate mission to save Earth from a mysterious substance threatening the Sun. An unexpected friendship may be the key to saving humanity.

themitchellsvsthemachines.title: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
themitchellsvsthemachines.description: The quirky Mitchell family sets out on a road trip to take their daughter Katie to film school. However, their journey is interrupted when intelligent machines launch a worldwide uprising against humanity. The dysfunctional family must work together to save the world from the robot apocalypse.

ronsgonewrong.title: Ron's Gone Wrong
ronsgonewrong.description: Barney, a socially awkward middle-school student, receives a robot named Ron that is designed to be his best friend. However, Ron has several malfunctions that make him behave differently from other robots. Together, they embark on an adventure that teaches them the true meaning of friendship.

wishdragon.title: Wish Dragon
wishdragon.description: Din, a determined teenager living in Shanghai, dreams of reconnecting with his childhood best friend Lina. When he discovers a magical teapot containing a wish-granting dragon named Long, he embarks on an extraordinary adventure that teaches him about friendship, happiness, and what truly matters in life.

wecanbeheroes.title: We Can Be Heroes
wecanbeheroes.description: When alien invaders capture Earth's greatest superheroes, their children are taken to a secure government facility. Led by a young girl named Missy Moreno, the kids must learn to work together and use their extraordinary powers to rescue their parents and save the planet.

detectivepikachu.title: Pokémon: Detective Pikachu
detectivepikachu.description: When private detective Harry Goodman mysteriously disappears, his son Tim travels to Ryme City to investigate. He encounters a talking Pikachu that only he can understand. Together, they search for clues about Harry's disappearance and uncover a dangerous conspiracy threatening the peaceful coexistence of humans and Pokémon.

sonic.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
sonic.description: After accidentally causing a massive power outage, Sonic, a blue hedgehog with incredible speed, attracts the attention of the evil scientist Dr. Robotnik. With help from a small-town sheriff named Tom, Sonic must escape Robotnik and prevent his powers from being used for world domination.

sonic2.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
sonic2.description: When Dr. Robotnik returns to Earth with a powerful new ally named Knuckles, Sonic teams up with his new friend Tails to find the legendary Master Emerald before it falls into the wrong hands.

sonic3.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
sonic3.description: Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles face their most powerful enemy yet, Shadow the Hedgehog, a mysterious rival with extraordinary abilities. To stop him, the heroes must form an unlikely alliance and confront a threat greater than anything they have faced before.

badguys.title: The Bad Guys
badguys.description: A notorious gang of animal criminals led by Mr. Wolf is finally captured after years of successful robberies. To avoid prison, they agree to pretend to become good citizens, but Mr. Wolf soon discovers that being good might actually be more rewarding than being bad.

badguys2.title: The Bad Guys 2
badguys2.description: The Bad Guys are trying to leave their criminal past behind and live as honest citizens. However, their peaceful lives are interrupted when a new all-female criminal gang forces them into one final dangerous heist.

elemental.title: Elemental
elemental.description: In Element City, residents made of fire, water, earth, and air live together despite their differences. Ember, a fiery young woman, meets Wade, a kindhearted water resident, and their unlikely friendship challenges their beliefs about the world and each other.

spacejam.title: Space Jam
spacejam.description: When alien creatures threaten to capture the Looney Tunes and take them to an amusement park, Bugs Bunny and his friends challenge them to a basketball game. To improve their chances of winning, they recruit legendary basketball star Michael Jordan.

spacejam2.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
spacejam2.description: Basketball superstar LeBron James and his son become trapped inside a digital universe controlled by a powerful artificial intelligence. To rescue his son and escape, LeBron must assemble a basketball team with Bugs Bunny and the Looney Tunes to defeat the Goon Squad.

minionsandmonsters.title: Minions & Monsters
minionsandmonsters.description: In 1920s Hollywood, the Minions set out to make their own monster movie and search for terrifying creatures to star in it. After accidentally unleashing real monsters, they must work together to save the world from the chaos they created.

polarexpress.title: The Polar Express
polarexpress.description: On Christmas Eve, a young boy who is beginning to doubt the existence of Santa Claus boards a mysterious magical train headed for the North Pole. Along the way, he experiences extraordinary adventures and learns about friendship, courage, and the spirit of Christmas.

meg.title: The Meg
meg.description: When a deep-sea research submarine is attacked by a massive prehistoric shark, expert rescue diver Jonas Taylor is recruited to save the trapped crew. As the enormous Megalodon escapes into the open ocean, Jonas and a team of scientists must find a way to stop the deadly creature before it threatens countless lives.

meg2.title: Meg 2: The Trench
meg2.description: Jonas Taylor and a research team explore the deepest parts of the ocean, where a dangerous mining operation disrupts their mission. They must fight for survival against enormous prehistoric Megalodon sharks and ruthless enemies threatening their lives.

scoobydoocyberchase.title: Scooby-Doo and the Cyber Chase
scoobydoocyberchase.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang investigate a mysterious computer virus at a university. When they become trapped inside a video game based on their adventures, they must complete a series of challenging levels and escape the dangerous Phantom Virus to return to the real world.

alohascoobydoo.title: Aloha, Scooby-Doo!
alohascoobydoo.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang travel to Hawaii for the Big Kahuna of Hanahuna surfing contest. However, their vacation turns into a mystery when a vengeful spirit known as the Wiki Tiki and his mysterious demons begin terrorizing the island.

scoobydoolochness.title: Scooby-Doo and the Loch Ness Monster
scoobydoolochness.description: Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Fred, Daphne, and Velma travel to Scotland to visit Daphne's cousin and attend the Highland Games. Their vacation turns into a mystery when the legendary Loch Ness Monster begins terrorizing the area, forcing the gang to investigate whether the creature is real or part of an elaborate scheme.

scoobydoohollywood.title: Scooby-Doo Goes Hollywood
scoobydoohollywood.description: Scooby-Doo dreams of becoming a big Hollywood star and leaving his Saturday morning cartoon behind. With Shaggy acting as his manager, Scooby auditions for different television shows and movies, while the rest of the Mystery Inc. gang tries to convince him to return to his friends.

scoobydoomexico.title: Scooby-Doo and the Monster of Mexico
scoobydoomexico.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang travel to Veracruz, Mexico, to visit Fred's friend Alejo Otero and his family. Their vacation turns into a frightening mystery when a terrifying creature known as El Chupacabra begins terrorizing the town and threatening the family's hotel.

legoscoobydoohollywood.title: LEGO Scooby-Doo!: Haunted Hollywood
legoscoobydoohollywood.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang visit an old Hollywood movie studio that is threatened with closure. When mysterious monsters from classic horror films begin appearing, the gang must uncover who is behind the hauntings and save the studio.

legoscoobydoopirates.title: LEGO Scooby-Doo! Blowout Beach Bash
legoscoobydoopirates.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang travel to Blowout Beach for a fun beach party. However, their vacation is interrupted when a group of ghost pirates begins terrorizing the area. The gang must investigate the mysterious pirates and save the beach celebration.

backrooms.title: Backrooms
backrooms.description: After a therapist's patient disappears into a mysterious dimension beyond reality, she ventures into an impossible world of endless rooms and corridors to find him and uncover the terrifying truth.

kpopdemonhunters.title: KPop Demon Hunters
kpopdemonhunters.description: Rumi, Mira, and Zoey are members of a world-famous K-pop girl group who secretly protect humanity from demons. When a rival boy band with supernatural origins threatens their fans, the three singers must use their powers and music to save the world.

minecraftmovie.title: A Minecraft Movie
minecraftmovie.description: Four ordinary people are transported through a mysterious portal into the Overworld, a strange block-shaped universe where imagination and creativity are essential for survival. With the help of an expert crafter named Steve, they must overcome dangerous creatures and find a way back home.

zootropolis.title: Zootropolis
zootropolis.description: In a city populated by animals, Judy Hopps becomes the first rabbit police officer. Determined to prove herself, she teams up with a clever fox named Nick Wilde to investigate a mysterious disappearance and uncover a conspiracy threatening the city.

zootropolis2.title: Zootropolis 2
zootropolis2.description: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde return as police partners to investigate a mysterious reptile named Gary De'Snake. Their investigation leads them into unexplored parts of Zootropolis and uncovers secrets that threaten to change the city forever.

singthriller.title: Sing: Thriller
singthriller.description: Buster Moon and his friends prepare a spectacular musical performance inspired by Michael Jackson's Thriller. However, the celebration takes an unexpected turn when mysterious slime transforms partygoers into dancing zombies.

minionsandmore.title: Minions & More 1
minionsandmore.description: A collection of hilarious animated short films featuring the mischievous Minions and other characters from the Despicable Me universe. The compilation includes adventures such as Training Wheels, Puppy, and Yellow Is the New Black.

minionsandmore2.title: Minions & More 2
minionsandmore2.description: Another collection of animated short films featuring the Minions and other beloved Illumination characters. The compilation includes funny adventures such as Phil's Dance Party and Binky Nelson Unpacified.

thesoccerfootballmovie.title: The Soccer Football Movie
thesoccerfootballmovie.description: Four young soccer fans join forces with famous football stars after a mysterious scientist steals the athletes' incredible talents. Together, the children must defeat the villain and help their heroes regain their abilities.

pixels.title: Pixels
pixels.description: When aliens mistake classic arcade video game footage for a declaration of war, they attack Earth using giant versions of famous video game characters. A group of former arcade champions must use their gaming skills to defend humanity.

planet51.title: Planet 51
planet51.description: American astronaut Captain Charles Baker lands on a distant planet inhabited by little green aliens who live in a society resembling 1950s America. The inhabitants believe he is a dangerous alien invader, but a young alien named Lem helps him escape capture and return to his spaceship.

meettherobinsons.title: Meet the Robinsons
meettherobinsons.description: Lewis, a brilliant young orphan and inventor, is determined to find his birth mother. When a mysterious boy named Wilbur Robinson takes him into the future, Lewis discovers an extraordinary family and must stop a villain known as the Bowler Hat Guy from changing history.

helpimafish.title: Help! I'm a Fish
helpimafish.description: Three children named Fly, Stella, and Chuck accidentally drink a mysterious potion that transforms them into sea creatures. Trapped underwater, they must find an antidote within 48 hours before their transformation becomes permanent, while facing an intelligent fish who wants to take over the ocean.

walle.title: WALL-E
walle.description: In a distant future where Earth has been abandoned by humanity, a lonely waste-collecting robot named WALL-E spends his days cleaning up the polluted planet. When he meets an advanced robot named EVE, he follows her into space and becomes involved in an adventure that could determine the future of humanity.

insideout.title: Inside Out
insideout.description: When 11-year-old Riley moves to San Francisco with her family, her emotions Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, and Disgust struggle to help her adjust. After Joy and Sadness accidentally become separated from headquarters, they must find their way back before Riley's emotional world falls apart.

insideout2.title: Inside Out 2
insideout2.description: As Riley enters her teenage years, her mind undergoes major changes when new emotions including Anxiety, Envy, Embarrassment, and Ennui arrive at headquarters. Joy and the original emotions must adapt as Riley struggles with friendship, growing up, and discovering who she really is.

coco.title: Coco
coco.description: Miguel, a young boy who dreams of becoming a musician despite his family's ban on music, accidentally enters the colorful Land of the Dead. With help from a charming skeleton named Hector, he sets out to discover the truth about his family's history and return to the living world.

findingnemo.title: Finding Nemo
findingnemo.description: When a young clownfish named Nemo is captured by a diver and taken to Sydney, his overprotective father Marlin sets out on a dangerous journey across the ocean to rescue him. Along the way, he meets a forgetful but friendly fish named Dory who helps him face sharks, jellyfish, and other dangers.

findingdory.title: Finding Dory
findingdory.description: Dory, a friendly blue tang fish with short-term memory loss, suddenly remembers that she has a family somewhere in the ocean. With help from Marlin and Nemo, she begins an extraordinary journey to find her long-lost parents, meeting new friends at a marine life institute along the way.

monstersinc.title: Monsters, Inc.
monstersinc.description: In a world inhabited by monsters, the city of Monstropolis gets its power from the screams of human children. When two monster workers, Sulley and Mike Wazowski, accidentally let a little girl named Boo enter their world, they must protect her and uncover a dangerous conspiracy at their company.

up.title: Up
up.description: Carl Fredricksen, an elderly widower, fulfills his lifelong dream of adventure by attaching thousands of balloons to his house and flying to South America. However, he discovers that an enthusiastic young Wilderness Explorer named Russell has accidentally joined him on the journey.

wreckitralph.title: Wreck-It Ralph
wreckitralph.description: Ralph, a video game villain tired of always being the bad guy, leaves his arcade game to prove that he can become a hero. His journey takes him through different video game worlds, where he meets a young racing character named Vanellope and accidentally unleashes a threat that could destroy the entire arcade.

encanto.title: Encanto
encanto.description: In a magical house hidden in the mountains of Colombia, every member of the Madrigal family has been blessed with a special power except Mirabel. When the family's magic begins to fade, Mirabel discovers that she may be the only one who can save their extraordinary home.

wish.title: Wish
wish.description: Asha, a young woman living in the magical kingdom of Rosas, discovers that King Magnifico controls the wishes of his people. When she makes a powerful wish upon a star, a magical being named Star comes down from the sky to help her challenge the king and restore hope to the kingdom.

thecroods.title: The Croods
thecroods.description: When their cave is destroyed, a prehistoric family led by the overprotective Grug must venture into a strange and dangerous world to find a new home. Along the way, they meet an inventive young caveman named Guy who introduces them to new ideas and helps them survive extraordinary creatures and challenges.

thecroods2.title: The Croods: A New Age
thecroods2.description: The Croods discover a beautiful paradise where they meet the Bettermans, a more advanced prehistoric family who believe they are superior. As the two families struggle to get along, a dangerous new threat forces them to work together to survive.

monstersuniversity.title: Monsters University
monstersuniversity.description: Mike Wazowski dreams of becoming a professional scarer and enrolls at Monsters University. There, he meets the naturally talented but arrogant James P. Sullivan. Despite their rivalry, the two monsters must learn to work together when they join a team of misfits competing in the university's Scare Games.

wreckitralph2.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
wreckitralph2.description: When Vanellope's racing game Sugar Rush is threatened with destruction, Ralph and Vanellope travel through a Wi-Fi router into the vast world of the internet. They explore websites, online games, and social media while searching for a replacement part to save her game, putting their friendship to the test.

minions.title: Minions
minions.description: Before meeting Gru, the Minions spend centuries searching for an evil master to serve. Kevin, Stuart, and Bob embark on a journey to find a new leader and meet Scarlet Overkill, a supervillain who plans to steal the British crown.

minions2.title: Minions: The Rise of Gru
minions2.description: In the 1970s, a young Gru dreams of becoming the world's greatest supervillain. With help from the Minions, he attempts to join the notorious Vicious 6, but his plans go wrong when he steals a powerful stone and becomes their enemy.

homealone.title: Home Alone
homealone.description: Eight-year-old Kevin McCallister is accidentally left behind when his family travels to Paris for Christmas. Initially enjoying his freedom, Kevin soon discovers that two burglars are planning to rob his house and prepares a series of clever traps to defend his home.

homealone2.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
homealone2.description: Kevin McCallister accidentally boards the wrong flight and ends up alone in New York City while his family travels to Florida. Using his father's credit card, he enjoys a luxurious holiday until he encounters the same two burglars, who are planning to rob a toy store on Christmas Eve.

homealone3.title: Home Alone 3
homealone3.description: Eight-year-old Alex Pruitt is home sick with chickenpox when four international criminals arrive in his neighborhood searching for a stolen computer chip hidden inside his toy car. When the criminals target his house, Alex creates clever traps to stop them.

homealone4.title: Home Alone 4: Taking Back the House
homealone4.description: Kevin McCallister spends Christmas at the luxurious mansion of his father's wealthy girlfriend. When his old enemy Marv returns with a new partner and plans to kidnap a visiting prince, Kevin must use the mansion's advanced technology and homemade traps to stop the criminals.

homealone5.title: Home Alone: The Holiday Heist
homealone5.description: Finn Baxter moves with his family into a mysterious old house in Maine that he believes is haunted. When his parents become stranded during a snowstorm, Finn and his sister must protect their home from three criminals searching for a valuable painting hidden inside the house.

homealone6.title: Home Sweet Home Alone
homealone6.description: Max Mercer is accidentally left behind when his family travels to Japan for Christmas. While enjoying his time alone, he discovers that a married couple is planning to break into his house to recover a valuable family heirloom. Max prepares elaborate traps to protect his home.

fivenightsatfreddys.title: Five Nights at Freddy's
fivenightsatfreddys.description: Mike Schmidt, a troubled security guard, takes a night shift job at the abandoned Freddy Fazbear's Pizza restaurant. He soon discovers that the restaurant's animatronic mascots come to life at night and hide a terrifying secret connected to missing children.

fivenightsatfreddys2.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
fivenightsatfreddys2.description: One year after the terrifying events at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, the story of the haunted restaurant has become a local legend. When Abby sneaks away to reunite with her animatronic friends, she uncovers dark secrets about Freddy's origins and accidentally unleashes an ancient horror that has remained hidden for decades.

theplatform.title: The Platform
theplatform.description: In a mysterious vertical prison, inmates are housed on different levels and receive food from a platform that descends through the building. Those on the upper floors eat first, leaving almost nothing for the prisoners below. A man named Goreng struggles to survive and attempts to change the cruel system.

theplatform2.title: The Platform 2
theplatform2.description: A new prisoner named Perempuan enters a brutal vertical prison where food is distributed through a descending platform. As a strict system of rules attempts to create fairness among the inmates, violent conflicts erupt between those who follow the rules and those who resist them. Perempuan must fight to survive and challenge the oppressive system.
